sources.total_units: offer doc p289 (THE ISSUE: 'Units issued and outstanding immediately after the Issue: 302,801,601*'; pre-issue 164,619,801).
sources.offer: offer doc p289 + cover (Issue 138,181,800* Units aggregating to ₹38,000* million at ₹275; = 45.63% of post-issue units). All-fresh; no OFS.
sources.sponsor_pct: offer doc p67 (Risk Factor 70: 'Upon completion of the Issue, 17.87% of the total number of Units will be held by our Sponsor and 36.49% by our Sponsor Group (excluding our Sponsor)') = 54.36% (= 164,619,801 / 302,801,601).

notes: Sponsor % = Sponsor + Sponsor Group, post-issue (17.87% + 36.49%). Sponsor is BSREP India Office Holdings V Pte. Ltd.
Market cap at IPO = ₹275 × 302,801,601 = ₹8,327 cr. % sold = ₹3,800cr ÷ ₹8,327cr = 45.63% (matches RHP's stated 45.63% of post-issue units).
